description: Working as an Application Developer at Fujitsu Technology Solutions, embedded in client-facing development teams in the banking sector. Responsible for maintaining, extending, and improving critical financial software infrastructure used by two major Spanish banks across two parallel project lines.
bullets: Developing and maintaining banking-grade software for high-availability financial systems serving millions of customers
Working in parallel across ATM middleware (CaixaBank) and financial monitoring (Banco Sabadell) product lines
Collaborating in hybrid Agile teams with multi-year product backlogs and large enterprise codebases
Applying rigorous testing and code review processes aligned with banking-sector compliance standards

projects.name: MDCS — ATM Banking Middleware (CaixaBank)
projects.description: Maintaining and extending the Device Control Software (MDCS) that powers approximately 11,000 CaixaBank ATMs across Spain. The system provides a Windows Service layer implementing the XFS (eXtensions for Financial Services) standard, enabling hardware-agnostic ATM software via standardised Device APIs.
bullets: Implemented XFS v3.0–3.5 compliant Service Providers for ATM hardware devices (card readers, cash dispensers, PIN pads)
Built JNI (Java Native Interface) bridges between Java client applications and C/C++ low-level device drivers
Developed XMODEM-based firmware update routines for remote ATM peripheral device updates
Integrated Libtomcrypt for cryptographic operations including PIN block handling and HSM key management
Created NSIS-based installer scripts for automated ATM software deployment packages across the fleet
Maintained Doxygen-generated API documentation for Device APIs and Service Provider interfaces

projects.name: Financial Monitoring & KPI Suite (Banco Sabadell)
projects.description: Development and maintenance of a suite of Java enterprise applications that collect, process, and visualise financial transaction data and KPIs for Banco Sabadell's ATM network. The suite handles 50,000–100,000 financial records per day and powers executive dashboards for real-time operational visibility.
bullets: Maintained and extended 'Recolectoras' (Java 8 / Maven) — the high-throughput data collection engine processing 50–100k financial records per day
Developed backend services in 'Servicios' and 'Portal' enterprise Java web modules for ATM management and regulatory reporting
Implemented 'ELAE (RecBsFj)' Spring Boot web service for real-time financial event processing and alerting
Optimised Oracle database performance using B-tree and Bitmap indexes and Materialized Views for reporting queries
Built interactive KPI dashboards using AngularJS with D3.js and Apache ECharts data visualisations
Managed Maven multi-module build system and maintained GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment

bullets: Designed and built a full-stack platform with role-based access control for four distinct user types (universities, teachers, students, rural organisations)
Implemented an AI-powered chatbot recommender combining keyword scoring with Gemini LLM fallback — achieving 95% intent recognition accuracy
Delivered 3–55ms API response latency across all endpoints under production load
Built internationalisation (i18n) infrastructure supporting 6 languages with dynamic locale switching
Achieved WCAG accessibility compliance throughout the React/Astro frontend
Implemented Cypress end-to-end test suite and Docker containerisation for reproducible CI/CD deployments
Deployed the production platform live at matchmaking.civenhance.eu
